# Brevard Coastal Homes

> Real estate search site for Brevard County, Florida (the Space Coast) — browse homes, condos, and land for sale, updated continuously from the MLS.

## About

- Brevard Coastal Homes is a real estate listing and search site covering Brevard County, FL, including barrier-island beach cities and mainland communities.
- Listings are sourced from the MLS and refresh continuously (price, status, and photos).
- The site is organized by city, by neighborhood, and by individual listing, with Area Guide pages providing local context (amenities, schools, HOA fees) and FAQs for many neighborhoods.

## Cities covered

- Cocoa Beach — /cocoa-beach
- Indialantic — /indialantic
- Indian Harbour Beach — /indian-harbour-beach
- Melbourne — /melbourne
- Melbourne Beach — /melbourne-beach
- Merritt Island — /merritt-island
- Rockledge — /rockledge
- Satellite Beach — /satellite-beach
- Viera — /viera
- Viera West — /viera-west

## Page types

- City listings, all types combined: /{city}
- City listings by type: /{city}/homes-for-sale, /{city}/condos-for-sale, /{city}/land-for-sale
- Oceanfront listings (barrier-island cities only): /{city}/oceanfront-homes-for-sale, /{city}/oceanfront-condos-for-sale, /{city}/oceanfront-listings
- Neighborhood listings: /neighborhoods/{slug}
- Neighborhood Area Guides (amenities, schools, HOA, FAQ): /neighborhoods/{slug}/area-guide
- Individual listing detail pages: /listings/{id}
- Sell your home: /looking-to-sell
- Contact: /contact
